name: Harbingers
source:
Nick, a social media influencer, has discovered a forbidden meeting in the ruins of an ancient Abbey, an international meeting of death-bringers. Recording the event will give his video channel the bump it desperately needs. But the harbingers aren't too happy about the business of death being exploited 'for views' and will do whatever it takes to keep their morbid work a secret.

Crispin, the influencer's editor, is monitoring his livestream from home. The question is, will he keep watching as the horrors of the evening unfold? What will happen to him if he survives? As he's about to discover...being dead isn't the end unless the harbingers permit it.

[From [url=https://seraten04.itch.io/harbingers]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
社交媒体网红尼克在一座古老修道院的废墟中，无意间撞见了一场禁忌集会——那是来自世界各地的“死亡使者”召开的秘密会议。只要拍下这场集会，就能为他急需流量的视频频道带来暴涨的热度。然而，这群死兆使者可不乐意看到死亡这门神圣行当被人拿来“博取播放量”，他们将不惜一切代价保守自己阴森事业的秘密。

与此同时，尼克的剪辑师克里斯平正坐在家中监看他的实时直播。问题是，随着当晚骇人听闻的恐怖一幕幕上演，他还会继续看下去吗？倘若他侥幸活了下来，又将遭遇怎样的命运？他很快便会明白……除非死兆使者们点头允许，否则死亡也绝非解脱的终点。

[摘自[url=https://seraten04.itch.io/harbingers]itch.io[/url]]
